mapper.select: SELECT to_char(r.RCPT_DT,'YYYYMM') AS "yearMonth",'RECEIPT' AS "category",sum(r.RCPT_AMT) AS "amount" FROM TB_BL_RCPT r JOIN TB_BL_BILL b ON b.BILL_ID=r.BILL_ID WHERE r.CNCL_YN='N' AND b.CNCL_YN='N' GROUP BY to_char(r.RCPT_DT,'YYYYMM') UNION ALL SELECT to_char(b.PAY_DUE_DT,'YYYYMM') AS "yearMonth",'REMAINDER' AS "category",sum(b.UNPAID_AMT) AS "amount" FROM TB_BL_BILL b WHERE b.CNCL_YN='N' AND b.UNPAID_AMT > 0 GROUP BY to_char(b.PAY_DUE_DT,'YYYYMM')

SELECT COALESCE(to_char(IO_DT,'YYYYMM'),FIN_YM) AS "yearMonth",'OTHER_INCOME' AS "category", sum(AMT+VAT_AMT) AS "amount" FROM TB_FI_ITEM WHERE FIN_CLS_CD='NOPR_IN' GROUP BY COALESCE(to_char(IO_DT,'YYYYMM'),FIN_YM)

SELECT PAY_YM AS "yearMonth",DEV_ID AS "developerId",EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeTypeCode", PAY_AMT AS "salary",ALWNC_AMT AS "allowance",INSR_CMPNY_AMT AS "companyInsurance", RETIRE_RSV_AMT AS "retirementReserve",INSR_SELF_AMT AS "personalInsurance",WTHLD_TAX_AMT AS "withholdingTax", INCM_TAX_AMT AS "incomeTax",REAL_PAY_AMT AS "netPay",VNDR_SPLY_AMT AS "vendorSupply" FROM TB_HR_MON_PAY WHERE PAY_YM <= #{end} ORDER BY PAY_YM,DEV_ID
SELECT DEV_ID FROM TB_HR_DEV WHERE USE_YN='Y'
